$comment: TenderScout shared design tokens: the single source of truth for the app (shared/tokens.css) and the website (site/src/styles/tokens.css for Tailwind, site/src/generated/tokens.ts for JS). Edit this file, then run `node shared/build-tokens.js`. Nobody hand-edits colours in two places. 4 Nov 2026 (declutter): the palette is nine colours per scheme (bg, surface, ink, muted, brand and the four verdict colours), no tints, no alpha, no gradients, no shadows, no grain, one 8 px radius, one typeface with no negative tracking, no uppercase, no italics. The website uses the dark scheme. Every value under `adjusted` differs from the designer's handoff and says why.

wordmark.$comment: There is no logo mark: the wordmark plus a brand dot is the signature on both the site and the app.

type.$comment: size / line-height / weight. Letter-spacing is 0 everywhere. `site` is the marketing page (desktop-first, fluid), `app` the 390 px phone prototype.

color.$comment: Nine colours per scheme. Text on a brand or verdict fill is always `bg`. Status text uses the verdict colour on bg or surface. No other colour exists in either product; the audit in check-contrast.js covers every pair that is used.

verdict.$comment: Never shown by colour alone: shape + label + colour, on the site and in the app. `check` is the requirement status the app adds for AI confidence under 70 %. Colours come from color.themes.

radius.$comment: One radius for everything with a corner (cards, buttons, inputs, score tiles, the sheet's top edge). Switches and the 8 px verdict circle are the only round things.

easing.$comment: One motion vocabulary for site and app (design/MOTION.md: enter easeOut, morph easeInOutQuart, pop easeOutBack).

duration.$comment: Milliseconds unless stated. The re-score choreography is shared by the site's PhoneDemo and the app's Company screen.

adjusted.handoff: three palettes (Brand, Sky, Harbor) × light/dark with soft tints, glass, hairlines, glow blobs, grain and per-component shades (about 60 values per theme)
adjusted.why: 4 Nov (declutter): the brief cuts the palette to background, surface, ink, muted ink, brand and the four verdict colours with no alpha and no tints. Sky and Harbor only differed from Brand by tints, glass and dock treatments that the brief removes, so they were dropped rather than kept as near-duplicates.
one brand colour has to work both as a fill under `bg` text and as text on white: #0862AC is 6.3:1 on white and 5.6:1 under #EEF3F8. The sky #5DB8F5 stays the dark scheme's brand.

adjusted.handoff: #F5A524 / #D0452C / #6145E0 fills with dark or white text, plus separate text colours
adjusted.why: one colour per verdict: each is ≥ 4.5:1 as text on white and on #EEF3F8, and ≥ 4.5:1 under `bg` text as a fill.
the former dark-scheme text colours become the one verdict colour: ≥ 7:1 as text on #02040A and #0B111C, ≥ 8:1 under `bg` text as a fill.

adjusted.handoff: 7 to 52 px, pills at 999 px, circles
adjusted.why: 4 Nov (declutter): one small radius; switches and the 8 px verdict circle are the only round things.

adjusted.handoff: IBM Plex Mono labels, −.015 to −.075 em headings, uppercase eyebrows, italic original titles
adjusted.value: Hanken Grotesk only, tracking 0, sentence case, regular weight in muted ink

adjusted.handoff: radial glow blobs, SVG grain overlay, layered shadows, soft-light photo tint, CSS stripe flags
adjusted.why: 4 Nov (declutter) rules 6, 13, 18: no gradients, no alpha surfaces, no text on photos; countries are written as text.
